import sys

MAXN = 2345678

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    total_nums, max_k = map(int, input[0:2])
    real_probs = list(map(float, input[2:2+total_nums]))
    count_valid = 0
    position_idx = []
    probs = []

    for i in range(total_nums):
        if real_probs[i] > 1e-4:
            position_idx.append(i)
            probs.append(real_probs[i])
            count_valid += 1

    max_k = min(max_k, count_valid)

    popcnt = [0] * (1 << count_valid)
    for mask in range(1, 1 << count_valid):
        popcnt[mask] = popcnt[mask & (mask - 1)] + 1

    dp_state = [0.0] * (1 << count_valid)
    final_results = [0.0] * total_nums

    dp_state[0] = 1.0

    for mask in range(1 << count_valid):
        if popcnt[mask] == max_k:
            for j in range(count_valid):
                if mask & (1 << j):
                    final_results[position_idx[j]] += dp_state[mask]
            continue
        sum_probs = 0.0
        for j in range(count_valid):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            sum_probs += probs[j]
        if sum_probs == 0:
            continue
        ratio = dp_state[mask] / sum_probs
        for j in range(count_valid):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            dp_state[mask | (1 << j)] += probs[j] * ratio

    print(' '.join(f"{final_results[i]:.17f}" for i in range(total_nums)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
